title: FM27 Guides — Football Manager 27 Index
description: FM27 guides: release date, platforms, free and paid Launch Preview dates, plus wonderkids, tactics, skins, mods and cheap-player guides.
meta: Release dates, Preview access and five Football Manager 27 guide topics.
body:
Football Manager 27 releases on 10 November 2026. This hub is the entry point to our FM27 coverage: five topic guides plus the release-date page, each of which starts as a method and becomes a dataset once the game is in players' hands.

FM27 release date and platforms

  • 10 November 2026 — FM27 on PC and Mac via Steam, Epic and the Xbox PC app, including Xbox Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass.
  • Day one, same date — FM27 Console on Xbox and PS5, FM27 Mobile via Netflix, and FM27 Touch on Apple Arcade for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV.
  • Retail price — £49.99; pre-purchase opens with the free Preview on 29 October, offering 10% off through SEGA-approved digital retailers. The full breakdown — per-platform dates and the Preview window — is on the FM27 release date page.

The Launch Preview: 29 October to 3 November

FM27 is free to play from 18:00 GMT on 29 October for five days, across Steam, Epic, the Microsoft Store, Xbox Game Pass and PC Game Pass, with every game mode available and no sign-up. The Launch Preview replaces what used to be called Beta or Advanced Access, and saves started during it continue into launch.

That window is the single most useful week in this whole cycle: it is the first build with a browsable database, a visible interface and a playable match engine, before full launch. Preview data and some club or player assets remain subject to rights-holder approval and may change.

After the free window ends at 18:00 GMT on 3 November, pre-purchasers can continue through the paid Launch Preview until 10 November. Game Pass access requires Xbox Game Pass Ultimate or PC Game Pass; the official announcement says eligible subscribers can continue through their subscription. Saves carry through both Preview phases into launch.

What we cover, by cluster

  • FM27 wonderkids — how the shortlist is built, PA bands, and why a credible list cannot exist before the database ships.
  • FM27 tactics — what Tactical Tweaks and Tactical Effectiveness change, the six checks before you download a tactic, and the shapes worth testing first.
  • FM27 skins — the install path, why FM26 skins need rebuilding for the new interface, and which FM26 skins are still maintained.
  • FM27 mods — real names fixes, logo and face packs, editor files and tools, sorted by what actually carries over from FM26.
  • FM27 cheap players & bargains — the filters that find value signings, and when the named list lands.

A separate database and editor guide — follows once the game ships and the editor is confirmed. We are not publishing an editor page before there is an editor to describe.

The update schedule

  • Now to 28 October: method pages. What each cluster needs, what counts as evidence, what we will not claim.
  • 29 October to 3 November: first pass on the Launch Preview build — tactics that survived a real test, the first wonderkid names, and whether the user-data folder matches FM26's layout.
  • 10 November onward: launch build revisions after each patch. Every entry carries the patch number and the date it was checked.

How these pages are built

FM guides fail on data, not prose. A wrong ability value or a tactic number that was never tested costs more trust than a missing section ever gains. So the rule across these guides is the same: no names, values or download links that were not read in a named build and dated. Where the honest answer is "this does not exist yet", the page says so and tells you when it will.

Sources are listed at the bottom of every page, and the site-wide editorial rules are on the editorial policy page. Broader game coverage sits in the guide hub.
